events.name: WuXi AppTec Co., Ltd.

statements.quote: The Deputy Secretary of Defense has decided to delist the following entity from the list of ``Chinese military companies'' in accordance with section 1260H, without prejudice to relisting the entity on additional or supplementary grounds:

The Deputy Secretary of War has determined that WuXi AppTec should be removed from the most recent Section 1260H List that was published in the Federal Register on June 10, 2026, in compliance with the order issued by the U.S. District Court of Columbia on August 7, 2026, granting WuXi AppTec's Motion for Preliminary Injunction, which enjoins the Department from enforcing, implementing, or otherwise giving effect to the Department's designation of WuXi AppTec as a Chinese military company under Section 1260H.
